description: This file defines a registration page component for a Next.js application using React and TypeScript. It handles user input for username, email, password, and confirmation, including client-side validation and API interaction for registration.

methods.name: RegisterPage
methods.description: React functional component rendering the user registration form, managing input state, validation, and invoking the registration API.
